title: La-Z-Boy Stationary Collection
source_note: Catalog facts below are transcribed from the supplied Summer/Fall 2026 stationary catalog text extraction. The catalog says to refer to current price books for complete details. Measurements are listed as H × W × D in inches unless the source itself uses another order. Availability and options remain style-specific.

stationary_prefix_definitions.description: Left-Arm Sitting Sofa with Attached Corner
Right-Arm Sitting Sofa with Attached Corner

options.name: Arm cap / headrest covers
options.details: Napkin-style arm caps and headrest covers are available with fabric orders; additional fabric or leather hides may be ordered for decorative detailing or repair.

options.name: No nailhead trim
options.details: Removes nailhead trim where it is a standard feature.

options.name: Black nailhead trim
options.details: Hammered black nickel trim; available on select styles.

options.name: Leg change
options.details: Changes standard legs to a different leg design.

options.name: Featherlite pillows
options.details: 95% duck feathers, 5% duck down, in 100% cotton down-proof ticking for additional support.

options.name: Contrasting pillows
options.details: Changes the fabric on accent pillows.

options.name: Contrasting second pillow set
options.details: Changes the fabric on a second set of accent pillows on styles supplied with two sets.

options.name: Tempur-Response memory foam mattress
options.details: Upgrade for Queen, Full, and Twin sleeper sizes.

options.name: SlumberAir mattress
options.details: SlumberAir mattress system upgrade for Queen, Full, and Twin sleeper sizes.

options.name: ComfortDown cushion
options.details: Upgrade from standard ComfortCore to pocketed-coil and high-resiliency foam core wrapped in a feather/down and fiber blend jacket.

options.name: ComfortCore with Contour cushion
options.details: Upgrade from standard ComfortCore seat cushions.

options.name: Left-hand power activator
options.details: Moves the two-button mounted controller with USB from right-side to left-side sitting.

options.name: Rechargeable lithium-ion battery pack
options.details: Cordless power for motion styles; catalog note says not available on lift chairs.

finishes.name: Graphite
finishes.details: Textured finish with understated gray tones.

pillow_styles.name: Long Knife Edge Kidney with Welt

warranty_reference.source: La-Z-Boy Stationary Catalog Part 1, warranty table and text
warranty_reference.raw_table_text: Premier sofas, sleep sofas, and sectionals table lists Frame; Show Wood; Springs and Spring Systems; Supreme Comfort mechanism; SlumberAir motor; polyurethane foam cushioning; ComfortCore cushion; ComfortCore with Contour cushion; ComfortDown cushion; fabric and leather; conserve fabric; antimicrobial fabric and leather; Restore by Nanobionic fabric; iClean fabric and leather combinations; Supreme Comfort mattress; SlumberAir mattress; Tempur-Response memory foam mattress. Premier sofas, sectionals, loveseats, and chairs table lists Frame; Show Wood; Springs and Spring Systems; Electrical Components; duo mechanism; ComfortCore cushion; fabric and leather; conserve; antimicrobial; Restore by Nanobionic; iClean variants; Battery Pack.
notes: The text extraction does not retain the warranty-table dot alignment for every component, so per-component year assignments are not reconstructed here.
Catalog warranty text says the majority of frames are backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty; consult current full written warranty terms.

One-year cover warranty text applies to seam failure, fabric separation, and nap loss; fabric and leather coverage concerns manufacturing and material defects; natural leather markings are not defects.
Specialty-fabric availability is stated as applying to most styles; consult CustomerCare for covered spills and exclusions.
